# TacticalEdgeIntelligence

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The deployment of neuromorphic computing and in-network processing at tactical edge nodes to perform low-latency pattern recognition and anomaly detection on sensor feeds. Critical for iNEST to achieve autonomous, energy-efficient decision-making in contested environments where connectivity to central command is unreliable.
